title: symmetry-aligned bilinear model chart
hypothesis: Hidden-neuron permutation alignment of four independently trained rotation-domain MLPs will improve interior bilinear chart quality versus unaligned weights, while all alignment metadata and endpoint payload bytes are charged.
physical_object: Four independently trained MLP domain checkpoints
mirror_coordinate: Bilinear chart coordinates (u,v), encoded as m=(2u-1,2v-1); native inverse is used as the exact control
logical_multiplicity: Twenty-five sampled bilinear surface views from four aligned or unaligned domain models
controls: unaligned independent domain checkpoints with bilinear interpolation
activation-correlation Hungarian hidden-neuron alignment then bilinear interpolation
uniform aligned and unaligned model soups
single pooled standard MLP trained on uniform four-domain mixtures

development.selection_metric: mean validation-domain NLL for independent endpoint training; learning rate selected from .03 and .1

data.alignment_probe: training images across all four rotations only; no labels used for neuron matching

training.endpoint_training: four independently initialized models, one per rotation domain, 60 epochs
training.alignment: compute centered activation-correlation matrix for hidden units on training probe inputs; solve maximum-weight one-to-one assignment with Hungarian algorithm; permute first-layer rows/bias and second-layer columns to match model 0
training.surface: bilinear interpolation of four endpoint weight states indexed by domain corners

evaluation.grid: 5x5 uniform u,v grid; each point evaluated on a heldout domain mixture with bilinear corner weights
evaluation.primary_metrics: worst/mean grid accuracy and NLL; endpoint accuracy; alignment permutation and wall time
evaluation.fresh_seed_meaning: independent initialization and training order replicates on one fixed split, not unseen-task generalization

paid_objects: permutation indices if raw checkpoint plus decode mapping is stored
25 coordinate codes or materialized model states
storage.coordinate_encoding: two float32 values per grid coordinate; same width for native and Mirror forms

report: alignment matrix MAC proxy and wall time

success_gate: Across all fresh seeds, aligned worst-grid accuracy improves over unaligned by at least 5 percentage points and reaches within 2 points of the pooled standard MLP; aligned endpoint functions remain unchanged within 1e-6 max logit difference; actual payload includes any stored permutation metadata; Mirror/native max logit delta <=5e-6.
failure_gate: Alignment does not improve grid quality by the preregistered margin, quality remains below pooled baseline, or Mirror chart only reproduces native bilinear coordinates. Report alignment utility separately from Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: Only a single hidden layer permutation is aligned; no claim about deep-network global symmetry solving.
Rotated Digits are a narrow synthetic vision setting.
Permutation matching uses train-only activation probes, no validation/test labels or logits.
Coordinate count is not independent model capacity.

amendments.reason: Add explicit pooled-standard control already required by the success gate; this correction is made before any fresh seed access and does not change model, training, or selection settings.
